grades.quote: The CSRRW (Atomic Read/Write CSR) instruction atomically swaps values in the CSRs and integer registers. CSRRW reads the old value of the CSR, zero-extends the value to XLEN bits, then writes it to integer register _rd_ . The initial value in _rs1_ is written to the CSR. If _rd_ = `x0` , then the instruction shall not read the CSR and shall not cause any of the side effects that might occur on a CSR read.
grades.reason: Explains special behavior when CSRRW targets x0, but not the general rule for writes to the constant-zero register.

grades.quote: C.MV is valid only when _rs2_ ≠ `x0` ; the code points with _rs2_ = `x0` correspond to the C.JR instruction. The code points with _rs2_ ≠ `x0` and _rd_ = `x0` are HINTs.
grades.reason: Identifies compressed instructions targeting x0 as HINTs under specified conditions, but does not explain the general handling of writes to x0.
